name: Argoverse 2 Motion Forecasting Dataset
description: Large-scale dataset for motion forecasting and trajectory prediction in autonomous driving, comprising 250,000 mined 11-second interactive scenarios across six US cities with rich vectorized HD map spline annotations.

size.notes: Exact aggregate compressed download size is not formally published in the documentation; distributed as Parquet scenario archives with accompanying vector maps.

citation.paper_title: Argoverse 2: Next Generation Datasets for Self-Driving Perception and Forecasting

provenance.collection_method: Mined from continuous autonomous driving logs across six geographically diverse US metropolitan areas; selected for challenging multi-agent interactions such as lane merges, intersection turns, and pedestrian crossings.
provenance.curation_notes: Separate catalog record from Argoverse 2 Sensor and LiDAR datasets. Contains 250,000 11-second trajectory sequences (5 seconds observation, 6 seconds prediction horizon) stored as structured Parquet files with vector map representations, without raw sensor sweeps.
